bullets: Free model rate limit errors now show the actual limit instead of a confusing refund message when waiting over a minute.
New chats in conversation mode now default to a slower, more measured model to prevent excessive context usage on simple greetings.
The daily usage meter now drains gradually as you use paid models instead of dropping all at once when a session starts.
The desktop app now allows up to 21 minutes for permission approvals that require extra clearance instead of five minutes.
The Standard section of the free model picker now hides most options behind a 'More' button for full-access users.
The assistant now suggests one specific next step after finishing a task, which can be quickly filled into your message box.
The model picker's single-model view now displays brief descriptions for each thinking level and updates its main heading text.
The hover text for the single-model view's information icon is now shorter, comparing only the fast and max modes.
A new standard web address for mobile app QR codes now directs users to the mobile download page.
The assistant's background work now allows up to 16 images from tool results in the conversation before trimming the oldest ones.
